title: User profile hub
summary: Admin and staff get a tabbed user profile hub with records, quick actions, internal notes, a unified activity timeline, and admin contact-preference and 2FA reset tools. Local development docs and scripts complete the Herd switch from Laragon.
changes: Admin user show is a tabbed profile hub (Overview, Details, Access, Records, Activity) with flash toasts for saves.
Records and Activity panels summarise tickets, cases, pets, bookings, applications and notes for the profile subject without exposing secrets.
Staff clients.show uses the same hub for public clients (staff accounts stay 404), gated by staff.clients.view for staff, volunteer and student roles.
Staff with the relevant view-all abilities can start a ticket or case owned by the client from the hub; ClientNote supports private notes visible only to the author and admins.
Admins can update contact preferences and reset TOTP 2FA for a user with audited actions and no secrets in flash or logs.
Local development documentation and preview scripts finish the Laragon-to-Herd switch (#846, #847).
version_rationale: Minor: new profile hub experience, staff.clients.view permission, client notes, and admin contact/2FA tools.
validation: PHPUnit feature coverage for UserProfileHubTest and AdminUserDetailUxTest.
composer pre-pr-verify and CI checks on the milestone pull request.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release tag and restore the previous database backup if the client_notes table or staff.clients.view grants need to be removed.
provenance: Milestone epic #517 and pull request #848 on the milestone/v0-66-0-user-profile-hub branch.
